results.name: The original vocabulary has bounded unique Japanese readings and useful word lengths
Vocabulary normalization and solutions preserve small kana and repeated physical letters
Draw, lock, unlock and finish conserve the exact nine tiles
Invalid actions and repeated drawing cannot create tiles or change the turn
Unregistered selections are rejected and locked words cannot be changed during the CPU turn
Three hints select an available word without completing it or revealing future draws
Discard gives exactly one CPU turn, then the player chooses a public draw
CPU choices do not depend on the opponent’s hidden hand
Corrupt saved progress falls back to finite bounded playable state
Reload and a new round preserve earned stats while selections stay valid
All practice recipes can be reached by drawing, choosing and discarding real tiles
